Credit Agreement (Credit Facility: Term Loan A Facility and Revolving Credit Facility)

parsed.notes: Both ratios are measured on a trailing twelve months basis ended September 30, 2026. Net leverage is consolidated funded debt, net of up to $100.0 million of unencumbered cash ($1,382.2 million), divided by Consolidated EBITDA as defined in the Credit Agreement. The pricing grid and commitment fees, which are also based on the net leverage ratio, were excluded because they only set rates and fees. The company reports compliance with all covenants.
